meanings.DECISION_1: Fine192 remains the scientific objective. Coarse96 failures remain in the original official record. Diagnostic384 provides non-authoritative pointwise refinement evidence only.
meanings.DECISION_2: The frozen gtol remains 1e-6. Stationarity must not be certified when derivative accuracy cannot resolve that tolerance. The exact operational derivative-certification method remains subject to validation. Coarse96/192 derivative agreement is not automatically mandatory if coarse96 is independently shown to be underresolved.
meanings.DECISION_3: No new five-family fitting campaign is authorized by this task.

accepted_engineering_principles: Fine192 is the only scientific objective.
Official coarse96 failures stay in the P1G-A record.
Stationarity is not certified when the derivative error cannot resolve 1e-6.
A coarse96 derivative mismatch is not by itself a fine192 derivative failure when coarse96 is underresolved.
unchanged_official_scientific_acceptance: P1G-A precision FAIL labels for baryon, mond and ptq-screen remain FAIL.
No model has an established MLE.
Likelihood, bounds, B0 floor, 91 galaxies and 1782 observations are unchanged.
proposed_future_numerical_methods: Operational derivative certification still requires the validation in this task.
Batched ledger persistence may be adopted only if the paired benchmark shows a real gain and durability holds.
unauthorized: Activation of a revised MLE acceptance rule
Declaring historical precision failures to be scientific PASS
